title: Weak Supervision Performance Evaluation via Partial Identification
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It evaluates a method for bounding the performance metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score) of weakly supervised machine learning classifiers without ground truth labels.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
